skill.name: Pre-commit Hook Validation
skill.description: Execute pre-commit hooks to automatically format and lint code before commits, with manual override capability for full-file validation.
skill.skill_body:
Run pre-commit hooks to validate code quality. Use 'pre-commit run --all-files' to manually check all files in the repository. Hooks execute automatically on commit; use this skill to proactively validate before staging changes.

## Objective

Enforce code quality standards via automated linting and formatting
## Applicable Signals

- Before committing code changes
- When validating code quality across an entire codebase
- After modifying multiple files
- During code review preparation

## Contraindications

- Emergency hotfixes where pre-commit checks are temporarily disabled
- Environments without pre-commit framework installed
- Systems where hook installation failed or was skipped

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Verify pre-commit installation', 'detail': 'Confirm pre-commit package is available in the environment'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Run automatic hooks on commit', 'detail': 'Hooks execute automatically when committing; no manual action required for standard workflow'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Manually validate all files (optional)', 'detail': "Execute 'pre-commit run --all-files' to proactively check entire codebase before commit"}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Review validation results', 'detail': 'Inspect output for linting and formatting issues; address any failures before proceeding'}

## Constraints

- Pre-commit must be installed via 'pip install pre-commit'
- Pre-commit hooks must be initialized with 'pre-commit install'
- Execution requires access to repository root directory

## Cautions

- Pre-commit hooks may modify files automatically (formatting); review changes before committing
- First-time hook execution may take longer as dependencies are installed
- Some hooks may require additional configuration in .pre-commit-config.yaml

## Output Contract

- All files pass linting and formatting checks; pre-commit run completes without errors or with only informational warnings. Exit code 0 indicates success.
